hints.title: Greedy Pre-Orientation
hints.text: Orient non-cut strings to their lexicographically larger reversal to maximize concatenated segments.

hints.title: Cut String Enumeration
hints.text: Iterate over each string as the cut location, testing both normal and reversed orientations at each cut split.

hints.title: Candidate Assembly and Comparison
hints.text: First replace each string with the greater of itself and its reverse. Then for each string index i, build the remaining loop suffix. Try both original and reversed versions of string i across every character split index j, forming candidate strings and tracking the maximum.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: L: total length of all characters
complexity.notes: Optimal greedy orientation with cut exploration across all character boundaries.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all 2^N combinations of reversals is exponential and unnecessary.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Greedily picking the larger orientation for untouched segments isolates search to cut string.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Untouched strings should always take their maximum lexicographical orientation.
